documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: Support for PLA/PETG
Bambu Support for PLA/PETG Safety Data Sheet SDS20250723S05
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its colour values "Nature (65102)" and "Black (65103)" have no published hex.

not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for glass transition, Vicat softening, heat deflection (1.8 and 0.45 MPa) and every mechanical row (Young's modulus, tensile strength, breaking elongation, bending modulus, bending strength, impact strength; X-Y and Z); the SDS section 9 says "No data available". Filament length and hardness are stated nowhere.

Composition conflict, so material.type is not written (neither verified nor not_published; left to review): the TDS (p.3, Other Physical and Chemical Properties) says "Composition Polylactic acid", while the SDS SDS20250723S05 (Jul. 23 2025, p.4-5, section 3) lists Thermoplastic Polyurethane 74.9-90 % by wt (CAS 1211-14-9), PETG 9.9-25 % (CAS 25640-14-6) and additive 0.1-15.2 %. Both are official documents of equal rank and they name different polymers, and material.type is the filament card's material, so no value is published until the owner confirms which document is right.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: melt index 14.3 ± 1.2 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature N/A, saturated water absorption rate 1.02 % (25 °C, 55% RH), spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), bed surface preparation glue, retraction length 0.6 - 1.0 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, max overhang angle 55°, max bridging length 30 mm, support "Turn on", odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products. TDS facts that have a key but are not stored as spec rows: chamber temperature 25 - 45 °C (thermal.chamber_temp is one number, a printer's chamber maximum, not a filament's recommended range; no filament file stores it) and the Nozzle Size row "0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm" (extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters is a printer and hotend capability; the row is kept as the nozzle compatible_with relation, as in most PLA and PETG files, PVA and Support for PLA (New Version); the Support for ABS, TPU for AMS, PLA Pure, ASA and PA6 files store their TDS Nozzle Size row under that key instead, so the filament class is split on this key).

SDS facts not stored: the model designation "S05-xx" (p.2, section 1: "Model : S05-xx(xx stands for any suffix)"), a code pattern rather than this product's model, so identity.model is not written (the builder writes "Support for PLA/PETG" from the reviewed identity map, which a curated official_doc row would outrank and replace; as in the other filament files); CLP "Not classified", no hazard pictogram, "Not hazardous goods" for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO-TI/IATA transport, SVHC "Not listed". Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Drying requirement differs between wiki pages (not a stored key): the support wiki 2.1 gives "Pre-print Drying: Required" and "Moisture Protection During Printing: Required"; the drying wiki Appendix I gives "Recommended" and "Not required but recommended"; the store page says "Recommended Drying before Use".

Store page copy to review: its Printing Tips › 4.Safety Tips carry a sub-bullet "As this filament contains highly hygroscopic wood fibers…", which neither the TDS nor the SDS composition supports (apparent template text from another filament).
Marketing prose is not used for numbers: "zero top interface spacing & Z distance" (feature block 2) is not stored.

Not cached, so not read: the store page's "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/85b0296f5ef74f0982819b0aabf0af7b.pdf; safety.certifications is left to review) and the wiki page https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/bambu-studio/support (slicer support settings) linked from the Printing Tips.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.05 mm) comes from the store page only (Product Features › bullet 6) and is written by the page layer (verified, official_page); it is not repeated here.

No compat.statement is written: the support wiki row "Support for PLA/PETG" (Hardware Compatibility: all printers, all nozzle types, all build plates, all AMS series) is carried as the printer and AMS family relations and as notes on the nozzle and plate relations; a joined statement would not be the source's own words.

Adjudication against the second extraction (58 field disagreements): locator separators, the combined nozzle relations (TDS Nozzle Size row; material-table wiki high-flow columns), the all-printers and AMS-series family relations (rather than per-column open-frame / enclosed printer and AMS / AMS lite rows) and the TDS Build Plate Type plate relations keep this file's form. material.spool_type stays the store bullet "High Temperature Reusable Spool" (unverified): the TDS rows give the spool's material and size, not its type. Not added from the second extraction: thermal.chamber_temp, extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters, identity.model and compat.statement (see above), and the "All nozzle types" / "All build plates" relations (target kind other, no product target; the support wiki sentences are quoted in the nozzle and plate relation notes). material.type is removed (the TDS / SDS composition conflict above). material.net_weight is written as 0.5 kg, the TDS's own figure. Second adjudication pass (2026-10-17), every (b) and (c) item re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, the three wiki pages and the store page: the second extraction's material.spool_type text "PC + ABS spool (temperature resistance 90 °C); diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm" joins the TDS rows Spool Material and Spool Size into words the TDS does not print, and names no spool type, so the store bullet stays; its identity.model "S05-xx" is the SDS designation with a wildcard suffix, which would outrank the page layer's "Support for PLA/PETG"; its compat.statement quote joins four wiki sentences with ellipses and would replace the page layer's compatibility text with words the wiki does not print as one statement; its thermal.chamber_temp {25, 45} is a range on a one-number key. The TDS rows themselves (Nozzle Size, Chamber Temperature, Spool Material, Spool Size) are confirmed as quoted in the notes above.
